entities.summary: Louis Hercule Timoléon de Cossé, 8th Duke of Brissac, was a French military commander and peer of France. He was the second son and eventual heir of Jean Paul Timoléon de Cossé, 7th Duke of Brissac, who was a Marshal of France.
